title: Triage clusters v1
description: The model-written clustering output validated by `papercut_clusters.py validate-clusters` (dev_docs/designs/2026-09-07-triage-and-route.md §4.1). This describes exactly the five fields the model writes, and only the STRUCTURAL shape of each -- the semantic checks (an id actually open, a target actually in the registry, effort/confidence values, improvement length) are separate script-level checks with their own messages, so a schema violation and a semantic violation are never reported the same way. `severity`, `class`, and `issue` are computed by the script and appear only in the enriched output printed by that subcommand -- they are never present in the model's input file.
